en: The Titanic’s last port of call, in 1912, was Queenstown, now Cobh, in Cork harbour.
it: L’ultimo scalo del Titanic, nel 1912, fu Queenstown, oggi Cobh, nel porto di Cork.

en: From Irish Dubh Linn, "black pool"; in Irish today it is mostly Baile Átha Cliath.
It began as a Viking settlement in 841.
The Book of Kells, an illuminated gospel of around 800, is kept at Trinity College.
it: Dall’irlandese Dubh Linn, "stagno nero"; oggi in irlandese si chiama per lo più Baile Átha Cliath.
Il Libro di Kells, un vangelo miniato dell’800 circa, è custodito al Trinity College.
